name: gunsnprices-mcp
description: Parse gun and ammo titles (model, caliber, cost per round); find GunsNPrices price comparison pages
long_description: US gun and ammo shopping helper from GunsNPrices (gunsnprices.com), a price comparison site that tracks 40+ US gun and ammo stores. It parses product titles into brand, model, caliber, magazine capacity and barrel length, identifies firearm models (50 brands, Glock part numbers decoded), looks up calibers, computes ammo cost per round, and returns GunsNPrices pages that compare current prices. Runs locally, sends no data anywhere, no API key. It has no live prices: it links to the GunsNPrices pages that have them.

tools.name: parse_product_title
tools.description: Parse a gun or ammo product title into brand, model, calibers, magazine capacity, barrel length, rounds per box and cost per round, with GunsNPrices price pages.

tools.name: identify_firearm_model
tools.description: Identify the brand, model family and exact model of a firearm (50 brands; Glock part numbers decoded).

tools.name: lookup_caliber
tools.description: Normalize a caliber name ('300 BLK', '12ga', '6.5 CM') or find calibers in a text; returns type and the ammo price page.

tools.name: cost_per_round
tools.description: Compute ammo cost per round from a price and a round count (or a title to read it from).

tools.name: find_price_comparison_pages
tools.description: Find GunsNPrices pages comparing current prices across 40+ US stores for a model, brand or caliber.

tools.name: list_supported
tools.description: List the 50 brands with model recognition or the 293 known calibers.
